description: This plot illustrates the performance of various retrieval methods by comparing MRR@10 against the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$).", features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", also uses a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines representing different methods. The "DPR w/o query" method is depicted by a solid black line without markers, which remains constant at approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis range. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" method is shown as a solid red line with circular markers; it begins at an MRR@10 of approximately 35.15 at x=1, rises steadily to a peak of roughly 35.8 at x=7, and ends at approximately 35.75 at x=10. The "DPR w/ document expansion" method is represented by a solid green line with upward-pointing triangular markers, starting at approximately 34.75 at x=1, maintaining a relatively steady trend with a slight peak near 34.9 at x=6, and concluding at approximately 34.8 at x=10. Finally, the "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" method is illustrated by a solid blue line with star markers; it starts at approximately 34.7 at x=1, fluctuates with peaks near 34.95 at x=2 and x=5, and experiences a general decline thereafter, ending at its lowest point of approximately 34.35 at x=10.
